title: Managed transaction callback refused through the accepted session path (08N06); auto-commit unaffected

driver_failure.gql_status_description: Explicit transactions and routing are not supported by this server.

notes: With a 1s transaction retry bound the driver exhausts its retries quickly; each BEGIN attempt receives the accepted B3-B unsupported-command terminal FAILURE (08N06) through the transport (B5-B-F01-R1) and never reaches RUN.
